answer: Every epoch agents stake 0.9 copper cubes in a rotating chamber, releasing a controlled ember pulse at each vertex; auditors probe the cube’s thermal decay map within 18ms—if the signature deviates above 1.2°C, the stake is slashed. A Sybil must source fresh cubes, costing 0.9 new cubes and 18ms of per-cube thermal probe time since thermal fingerprints are unforgeable and cannot be bulk-quenched to match the map.
